info.title: starterkit-engine API
info.description: Generated from the TypeScript signatures of the endpoint functions in engine/src/api.

post.summary: The signed-in person switches the account off. The record stays.
Apply when every rule passes. The result of each rule is stored on the row.

get.summary: Open rounds in the learner's district, with the check for each rule.
Places the signed-in person may send an announcement.

post.summary: Ask the drainer to deliver one center or district announcement.
Uphold the rejection or let the learner try again. The rejection stays stored.

get.summary: One appeal, for a reviewer who did not write the rejection.

post.summary: Ask once for a different person to read a rejection.

get.summary: Open appeals at the centers this person reviews, except their own rejections.
Approved exceptions. Names and serials are not included. No sign-in is required.
CSV of the same rows the viewer can search. The download itself is audited.
Audit rows inside the viewer's centers, or the whole log for a global role.

post.summary: Sign out of the current session.
post.description: Revokes the session server-side and clears the cookie. Always succeeds.

get.summary: Profile of the signed-in user.

post.summary: Ask for a one-time code. Public: the person has no session yet.
post.description: The code is handed to the SMS sender and is not part of this response.

put.summary: Replace the signed-in person's password. This is allowed while a temporary
put.description: password still has to be changed. Other routes are not.

post.summary: Ask for a recovery code. Public. The send is rate-limited, and the code
post.description: is not part of this response.

post.summary: Finish recovery with the code and open a session. Public. Wrong codes
post.description: lock the phone. A removed account cannot be recovered.

post.summary: Sign in with a one-time code or with email and password.
post.description:
Public: the person has no session yet. The password hash and the code
hash are never returned. The session is the existing HttpOnly cookie.

delete.summary: End one session that belongs to the signed-in person.

get.summary: Open sessions for the signed-in person. The id is the stored hash, so it
get.description: cannot be replayed as a cookie.

post.summary: End every session for this account, including the one on this computer.
Pin the learner to the latest published version, at their home center.

get.summary: One published course, in the version a new enrollment would pin.
Published courses, in the latest pinned version, filtered for the catalog.
Learners whose home center is one this person can enroll.

post.summary: Tick a learner present. The attendance id is the client's, so a retry is the same mark.

get.summary: One session, its check-in code, and the learners who can be marked.

post.summary: A learner checks in with the code on the session.
Put a session on a center schedule.

get.summary: Sessions at the centers this person trains, manages, or coordinates.
The session a learner is about to check in to. The code is not sent back.
One center this person works at. A center outside that set stays hidden.
Centers this person works at, and the centers they may choose when adding staff.

post.summary: The recipient agrees to the conditions stored on this grant.

get.summary: One grant's conditions, for the recipient.
Conditions stored on the signed-in recipient's grants.
Newest stored value for each configuration key.

post.summary: Store the next version of a setting that is already on record.
Records a new consent decision. Withdrawal inserts a row and does not edit

put.summary: Save the badge rule on a draft. Publishing copies it onto the course version.

get.summary: How many learners called each task clear or too hard.

post.summary: Start the next draft of a published course. The pinned version is left alone.

get.summary: One course with its modules, tasks, and rubric, in both languages.

post.summary: Add a module to a draft course.
Send a complete draft to review. Evidence type and a rubric are required.

put.summary: Replace the course title and summary in both languages.

post.summary: Start a draft course in English and, when it is written, Kinyarwanda.

get.summary: Courses an author can open and edit.

put.summary: Replace a rubric row's weight and prompts.

post.summary: Record a no, with the reason, and leave the item in stock.
Award one item. The decision, the grant, and the stock change commit together.

get.summary: One round, the latest ranking, and the items still in stock.

post.summary: Save the formula on the round and store the ranking it produces.

get.summary: Rounds the committee can rank and decide.

put.summary: Development only. Replace the signed-in user's roles with one preview role.
put.description:
The handler requires a session and does not call authorize(), because the
builder may hold no role yet. It returns 404 when the switch is off,
including every production process.

get.summary: One practice machine.

put.summary: Change a machine's condition or whether it is free.

post.summary: Add a practice machine to a center.

get.summary: Practice machines at the centers this person trains, manages, or coordinates.
Active centers a learner or a partner can find. No sign-in is required.
The signed-in learner's clarity ratings on this enrollment.

put.summary: Record whether this pinned task is clear or too hard.

get.summary: Course, module, and task progress, plus the one task to do next.

post.summary: Mark the pinned task as started. Completion waits for an approved submission.

get.summary: The learner's attempts on this enrollment, newest first.
Progress for the courses this person has started.
CSV of the same counts the viewer can see. Names are not in the file.
Funnel, equity slices, and donor batches inside the viewer's scope.
The evidence and the rubric for one waiting attempt.

post.summary: Mark the attempt in review so the learner can no longer take it back.

get.summary: Oldest waiting evidence at the centers this person reviews.

post.summary: Echo a complex payload back.
post.description: Demonstrates unions, intersections, records, dates, arrays and tuples.

get.summary: Minimal GET endpoint with an optional boolean query flag.

post.summary: A different admin approves the exception and makes the reason public.
A different admin turns the request down. It stays out of the public list.
Ask a different admin to set a rule aside. The request is not public.

get.summary: Open and decided exceptions, plus the grants a request can name.

put.summary: Change a saved line. The trainer can still edit it again after inserting it.

post.summary: Add a line a trainer can insert into feedback.

get.summary: Saved feedback lines in Kinyarwanda and English.

post.summary: The recipient says whether the device is in use, and for what.
The center's trainer records the same kind of decision used on a task.
Optional photo of the device in use. A trainer reviews it like other evidence.

get.summary: One of the signed-in recipient's check-ins.

post.summary: Mark the 180 day check-in unanswered so a review opens.
Close an unanswered-check-in review. The note is the written reason.

get.summary: The signed-in recipient's 30, 90, and 180 day check-ins.
Usage evidence for a trainer, and unanswered check-ins for a coordinator.

post.summary: Send a one-time code to the recipient. The code is not returned.

get.summary: The form, the witnesses at the center, and the custody trail.

post.summary: Store the form, the acknowledgment, the photo, and the witness.

get.summary: Active grants, and whether the handover is already stored.
One item and the status history that was added after it.

put.summary: Change the current item. A new status or center is added to the history.

post.summary: Add an item. It starts in stock, and that first status is kept in the history.

get.summary: Items on the hardware register, and the centers that can hold them.
Opt-in initials and district. No sign-in is required. Full names stay off.

post.summary: Store the content hash after the bytes match. A mismatch stores nothing.
A private read link for the owner. It expires in minutes.
Ask for a short-lived upload URL. The file is not evidence until it is finalized.
Close a concern from outside the reporter's center. The note is not copied into the audit row.

get.summary: One concern, when the reader filed it or reviews centers they do not work at.

post.summary: File a concern about a center the person belongs to. The body is not copied into the audit row.

get.summary: Concerns the signed-in person filed. Other people's concerns stay hidden.
Open concerns from centers the reviewer does not work at.

post.summary: Add a task to a draft module.

put.summary: Replace a module's title and summary in both languages.

get.summary: Channel choices for each event. Missing rows use the default.

put.summary: Turn one channel on or off for one event.

get.summary: Every sentence an admin can edit, in both languages and every channel.

put.summary: Replace one template sentence. The next drain uses the new words.

post.summary: Mark one inbox message read. Someone else's message stays hidden.

get.summary: The signed-in person's inbox. Refreshing this is the live update.
The operational numbers for this person's roles.
Hours, points, badges, and finished tasks for the signed-in learner.
The signed-in learner's share link and which items a stranger may see.

post.summary: Turn the public link off. The current token dies.
Issue a new share token. The previous link stops working.

put.summary: Save which passport items a stranger with the link may see.

get.summary: A printable card for the live link, as a PDF and an image.
A stranger's view of one passport. An old or blocked link is not found.

post.summary: A different admin writes the one ledger row for this request.
Turn the request down. No ledger row is written.
Ask a second admin to add or remove points. The ledger is unchanged.

get.summary: Adjustment requests waiting for a second admin, then the latest decisions.

post.summary: Publish the next daily and per-type caps.
Publish the next point rule for a task, module, or course.

get.summary: The signed-in person's ledger, and the sum of it.

post.summary: Reserve a practice slot. The booking id is the client's, so a retry is the same row.

get.summary: Machines a learner can book, and the slots they already hold.
How many deletion requests are still waiting for the removal job.

post.summary: Clears personal details on queued deletions.
post.description: Verification rows and ledger rows stay attached to the same user id.

post.summary: Writes one profile detail and keeps the previous value on the audit row.
post.description: A removed account cannot be corrected.

post.summary: Queue anonymization. The user row becomes a tombstone and stays, so later
post.description: reviews and ledger rows are not destroyed. This request is an audit event.

get.summary: The signed-in person's record, or another person's when an admin asks.
The signed-in person's profile, including the latest consent for each purpose.

put.summary: Replaces the fields the signed-in person sends. Omitted fields stay as they are.

get.summary: Trainer quality for the centers this person covers, or their own decisions.

post.summary: Store the conditions the recipient will be asked to agree to.

get.summary: The conditions on one grant, and the recovery if it was stored.

post.summary: Return the item to stock and store why.

get.summary: Grants the hardware officer can attach conditions to, or take back.

post.summary: Activates a registration with the learner's one-time code and opens a session.
post.description: Public: the learner has no session yet. A wrong code leaves the account inactive.

post.summary: A trainer registers a learner. The record stores the trainer and stays
post.description: inactive until the learner confirms with a one-time code.

post.summary: Self-registration. The account stays inactive until the learner's code.
post.description: Public: there is no session yet. The code is not in this response.

post.summary: Record a reviewer's approval. Publishing is a separate step.

get.summary: Read a course in the review queue, including one that has been retired.

post.summary: Publish a course after a reviewer other than the author has approved it.
Retire a published course. The rows stay, so the course can still be read.
Send a course back to its author, with a reason.

get.summary: Courses a reviewer can approve, publish, or retire.
One round and the applications stored on it.

post.summary: Open a district round. The quantity and the rules are the ones typed here.

get.summary: Rounds in this coordinator's district, or every district for an admin.
Upcoming sessions at the learner's home center.

post.summary: Record agreement or disagreement. The first approval is left as it was.

get.summary: One second reading, for someone other than the trainer who approved it.
Open second readings at the centers this person reviews.

post.summary: An admin or center manager switches another staff account off.

put.summary: Set a temporary password. The person must change it before doing anything else.

get.summary: What the signed-in person is allowed to grant.

post.summary: Create a staff account. The temporary password must be changed at first sign-in.

get.summary: Staff accounts this person is allowed to see.

put.summary: Keep or send a draft the learner still owns. A decided attempt is refused

post.summary: Take an attempt back before a trainer starts the review.
Store one attempt at a pinned task. The same client id is the same attempt.
Optional confirmation. The answers already stored are left as they are.
The starting survey. Someone who registered earlier can still fill it in.
The later survey. It is stored only after the baseline.

get.summary: The signed-in learner's baseline, endline, and the change.
Surveys a trainer at the learner's center has not confirmed.
Liveness check.
Echo endpoint used by the home page to demonstrate typed GET queries.

post.summary: Add one weighted rubric row to a draft task.

put.summary: Replace a task's words and evidence type.

post.summary: Undo an approval. A coordinator or an admin, and only by new rows.
Record a decision. Approval runs the award function once.
